```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The cost of a college education has been on an unsustainable trajectory, rising year by year faster than inflation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Nationwide, student debt now exceeds credit card debt, with average debt levels per student totaling roughly $27,000.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Delinquency rates on student loans are as high as they were on subprime mortgages during the housing crisis.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Over half of recent college graduates are unemployed or underemployed, working at jobs for which their expensive educations gave them no preparation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"New systems of learning are needed to compete with traditional four-year schools, including technical institutions, online universities, life-long learning, and work-based learning in the private sector.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Public policy should advance the affordability, innovation, and transparency of new systems of learning.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A four-year degree from a brick-and-mortar institution is not the only path toward a prosperous and fulfilling career.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The federal government should not be in the business of originating student loans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Restoring private sector participation in student financing will bring down college costs and give students access to a multitude of financing options.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Any regulation that increases college costs must be challenged to balance its worth against its negative economic impact on students and their families.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
